Your Agent v%1$s — your personal AI assistant with Agent Mode and an APK Factory
Main features: • Streaming chat with your AI brain of choice (BYOK: Groq, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Gemini, or your own server) • Agent Mode: 16 skills — calculator, notes, long-term memory, web fetch, project generator, APK factory, core fullstack skill • APK Factory: turn Android apps & games into real APK files right from chat • Smart Generator: code written by AI following your instructions, checked by validators, template fallback • Per-reply token info + live backend quota (strip on the main screen & the Quota card here) • Confirmation gate for destructive actions • Local chat history + sessions & memory stored on the backend
